sub_graphs.name: Fork Trigger Condition
sub_graphs.description: Defines the condition under which the Fulu fork is activated. The fork is triggered at a specific epoch (FULU_FORK_EPOCH). The irregular state change occurs when the slot is at an epoch boundary (state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0) and the current epoch equals FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

invariants.text: The Fulu fork upgrade MUST only occur at an epoch boundary, i.e. when state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0.
The Fulu fork upgrade MUST only occur when compute_epoch_at_slot(state.slot) == FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

post_conditions.text: The beacon state has been upgraded from Electra to Fulu via upgrade_to_fulu.

state_transitions.text: An irregular state change is made: the pre-fork Electra BeaconState is transformed into a post-fork Fulu BeaconState.

state_variables.name: FULU_FORK_EPOCH
state_variables.description: The epoch at which the Fulu fork is triggered. Configuration value (not yet definitive).

state_variables.name: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH
state_variables.description: Number of slots per epoch, used to determine epoch boundaries.

sub_graphs.name: upgrade_to_fulu State Upgrade Function
sub_graphs.description: The core function that performs the Fulu fork upgrade. It takes a pre-fork Electra BeaconState and constructs a new Fulu BeaconState, copying over all existing fields and initializing new Fulu-specific fields.

invariants.text: All fields from the pre-fork Electra BeaconState MUST be preserved in the post-fork Fulu BeaconState (except those explicitly modified or added).
The fork.previous_version in the post state MUST equal the fork.current_version from the pre state.
The fork.current_version in the post state MUST equal FULU_FORK_VERSION.
The fork.epoch in the post state MUST equal the current epoch at the time of upgrade.
Validator set (validators, balances) MUST be identical between pre and post states.
Finality data (justification_bits, justified checkpoints, finalized checkpoint) MUST be identical between pre and post states.
Pending operations (pending_deposits, pending_partial_withdrawals, pending_consolidations) MUST be identical between pre and post states.

pre_conditions.text: The input state (pre) MUST be a valid electra.BeaconState.

post_conditions.text: The returned state is a valid Fulu BeaconState with fork.current_version == FULU_FORK_VERSION.
The returned state contains a newly initialized proposer_lookahead field (EIP-7917).

state_transitions.text: The Electra BeaconState is converted into a Fulu BeaconState by constructing a new BeaconState object with all fields copied and fork version updated.

functions.name: upgrade_to_fulu

parameters.name: pre
parameters.description: The pre-fork Electra beacon state to upgrade.

functions.description: Constructs a new Fulu BeaconState from an existing Electra BeaconState. Copies all existing fields, updates the Fork object to reflect FULU_FORK_VERSION, and initializes the new proposer_lookahead field via initialize_proposer_lookahead.
modifications: [Modified in Fulu] Fork.current_version set to FULU_FORK_VERSION
[New in Fulu:EIP7917] proposer_lookahead initialized via initialize_proposer_lookahead(pre)

state_variables.name: FULU_FORK_VERSION
state_variables.description: The fork version identifier for the Fulu fork.

sub_graphs.name: Fork Version Transition
sub_graphs.description: Defines how the Fork object within BeaconState is updated during the Fulu upgrade.

invariants.text: Fork.previous_version MUST equal the pre-state Fork.current_version to maintain fork chain continuity.
Fork.current_version MUST be set to FULU_FORK_VERSION.
Fork.epoch MUST equal the epoch at which the upgrade occurs.

fields.name: previous_version
fields.description: Set to pre.fork.current_version during upgrade.

fields.name: current_version
fields.description: Set to FULU_FORK_VERSION during upgrade.

fields.name: epoch
fields.description: Set to the current epoch at the time of upgrade.

sub_graphs.name: Fulu BeaconState Structure
sub_graphs.description: The complete Fulu BeaconState structure as constructed by upgrade_to_fulu. It inherits all fields from Electra BeaconState and adds new fields introduced in the Fulu fork.

sub_graphs.name: EIP-7917 Proposer Lookahead Initialization
sub_graphs.description: Introduces the proposer_lookahead field to the Fulu BeaconState. This is a new feature from EIP-7917.

invariants.text: The proposer_lookahead field MUST be initialized during the fork upgrade using initialize_proposer_lookahead(pre).
The proposer_lookahead field MUST contain valid ValidatorIndex values for the lookahead window.

pre_conditions.text: A valid pre-fork Electra BeaconState must be available as input to initialize_proposer_lookahead.

post_conditions.text: The proposer_lookahead field is populated with a valid sequence of proposer indices for the lookahead period.

state_transitions.text: The proposer_lookahead field transitions from non-existent (in Electra state) to initialized (in Fulu state).
state_transitions.from_state: N/A (field does not exist in Electra)

sub_graphs.name: State Field Continuity Guarantees
sub_graphs.description: Ensures that all inherited fields from the Electra BeaconState are faithfully carried over to the Fulu BeaconState during the fork upgrade.

invariants.text: genesis_time MUST be unchanged across the fork.
genesis_validators_root MUST be unchanged across the fork.
slot MUST be unchanged across the fork.
latest_block_header MUST be unchanged across the fork.
All historical data fields (block_roots, state_roots, historical_roots, historical_summaries) MUST be unchanged across the fork.
All eth1 data fields (eth1_data, eth1_data_votes, eth1_deposit_index) MUST be unchanged across the fork.
The validator registry (validators) and balances MUST be unchanged across the fork.
randao_mixes and slashings MUST be unchanged across the fork.
Epoch participation flags (previous_epoch_participation, current_epoch_participation) MUST be unchanged across the fork.
All finality fields (justification_bits, previous_justified_checkpoint, current_justified_checkpoint, finalized_checkpoint) MUST be unchanged across the fork.
inactivity_scores MUST be unchanged across the fork.
Sync committee fields (current_sync_committee, next_sync_committee) MUST be unchanged across the fork.
latest_execution_payload_header MUST be unchanged across the fork.
Withdrawal fields (next_withdrawal_index, next_withdrawal_validator_index) MUST be unchanged across the fork.

All Electra-specific fields (deposit_requests_start_index, deposit_balance_to_consume, exit_balance_to_consume, earliest_exit_epoch, consolidation_balance_to_consume, earliest_consolidation_epoch, pending_deposits, pending_partial_withdrawals, pending_consolidations) MUST be unchanged across the fork.

metadata.fork_lineage: Phase0 -> Altair -> Bellatrix -> Capella -> Deneb -> Electra -> Fulu

sub_graphs.name: Preset and Configuration Constants
sub_graphs.description: Defines the preset and configuration constants introduced or modified in the Fulu fork for the P2P networking layer. Includes the KZG commitments Merkle inclusion proof depth and new data column sidecar subnet parameters (EIP-7594).

invariants.text: KZG_COMMITMENTS_INCLUSION_PROOF_DEPTH MUST equal uint64(floorlog2(get_generalized_index(BeaconBlockBody, 'blob_kzg_commitments'))), which equals 4.
DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT MUST be 128.
MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS MUST equal MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS.
MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS MUST be 2^12 (4096 epochs, approximately 18 days).

state_variables.name: KZG_COMMITMENTS_INCLUSION_PROOF_DEPTH
state_variables.description: Merkle proof index depth for blob_kzg_commitments in BeaconBlockBody.

state_variables.name: DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT
state_variables.description: The number of data column sidecar subnets used in the gossipsub protocol. New in Fulu:EIP7594.

state_variables.name: MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS
state_variables.description: Maximum number of data column sidecars in a single request.

state_variables.name: MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS
state_variables.description: The minimum epoch range over which a node must serve data column sidecars (approximately 18 days).

sub_graphs.name: DataColumnsByRootIdentifier Container
sub_graphs.description: Defines the DataColumnsByRootIdentifier SSZ container used to identify specific data columns by block root and column indices in Req/Resp requests.

fields.name: block_root
fields.description: The block root identifying the beacon block.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: List of column indices to request for the given block root.

sub_graphs.name: Fork Version Computation (Modified)
sub_graphs.description: Modifies the compute_fork_version helper function to include the Fulu fork epoch. Returns the appropriate fork version for a given epoch by checking against all known fork epochs in descending order.

invariants.text: For epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH, the function MUST return FULU_FORK_VERSION.
Fork version checks MUST be evaluated in reverse chronological order (newest fork first) to ensure the correct version is returned.

preconditions.text: The epoch parameter must be a valid Epoch type.

postconditions.text: The returned Version corresponds to the fork active at the given epoch.

functions.description: Returns the fork version at the given epoch. Checks fork epochs in order: FULU, ELECTRA, DENEB, CAPELLA, BELLATRIX, ALTAIR, then falls back to GENESIS_FORK_VERSION.

sub_graphs.name: Data Column Sidecar Validity Verification
sub_graphs.description: Defines the verify_data_column_sidecar helper function that performs structural validity checks on a DataColumnSidecar. Ensures the sidecar index is within range, the blob count is non-zero, the blob limit is respected for the epoch, and the column/commitment/proof lengths are consistent.

invariants.text: A sidecar with index >= NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS is always invalid.
A sidecar with zero kzg_commitments is always invalid.
The number of kzg_commitments MUST NOT exceed get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block for the sidecar's slot epoch.
len(sidecar.column) MUST equal len(sidecar.kzg_commitments) MUST equal len(sidecar.kzg_proofs).

preconditions.text: The sidecar parameter must be a well-formed DataColumnSidecar.

postconditions.text: Returns True only if all structural validity checks pass; False otherwise.

functions.description: Verifies structural validity of a data column sidecar: index range, non-zero blobs, blob limit per epoch, and length consistency between column, commitments, and proofs.

sub_graphs.name: Data Column Sidecar KZG Proof Verification
sub_graphs.description: Defines the verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs helper function that performs batch verification of KZG proofs against commitments for a data column sidecar. Uses the column index as the cell index for all cells in the column.

invariants.text: The cell_indices array MUST contain len(sidecar.column) copies of CellIndex(sidecar.index), reflecting that all cells in a column share the same column index.

preconditions.text: The sidecar must have already passed verify_data_column_sidecar (structural validity).

postconditions.text: Returns True if and only if the batch KZG cell proof verification succeeds for all cells against their respective commitments and proofs.

functions.description: Batch verifies that the cells in the sidecar column match the corresponding KZG commitments and proofs. The column index is used as the cell index for all cells.

error_cases.result: Returns False, indicating KZG proof mismatch

sub_graphs.name: Data Column Sidecar Inclusion Proof Verification
sub_graphs.description: Defines the verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof helper function that verifies the Merkle inclusion proof of the KZG commitments within the beacon block body root.

invariants.text: The Merkle branch depth MUST equal KZG_COMMITMENTS_INCLUSION_PROOF_DEPTH (4).
The leaf MUST be hash_tree_root(sidecar.kzg_commitments).
The root MUST be sidecar.signed_block_header.message.body_root.

preconditions.text: The sidecar must contain a valid signed_block_header and kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof.

postconditions.text: Returns True if and only if the Merkle branch is valid, proving that the kzg_commitments are included in the beacon block body.

functions.description: Verifies that the KZG commitments are included in the given beacon block via a Merkle branch proof against the body_root.

error_cases.result: Returns False, indicating the KZG commitments are not properly included in the block

sub_graphs.name: Data Column Sidecar Subnet Computation
sub_graphs.description: Defines the compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar helper function that deterministically maps a column index to its gossipsub subnet using modular arithmetic.

invariants.text: The subnet ID MUST equal column_index % DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT.
The returned SubnetID MUST be in range [0, DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT).

preconditions.text: column_index must be a valid ColumnIndex.

postconditions.text: Returns a deterministic SubnetID for the given column index.

functions.description: Computes the gossipsub subnet ID for a data column sidecar based on its column index modulo DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT.

sub_graphs.name: MetaData Structure Extension
sub_graphs.description: Extends the MetaData structure with a custody_group_count field to communicate the node's custody group count to peers. This is critical for the PeerDAS (EIP-7594) protocol where nodes must advertise how many custody groups they serve.

invariants.text: Clients MAY reject peers with a custody_group_count value less than CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT.

fields.name: seq_number
fields.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number (unchanged from Altair).

fields.name: attnets
fields.description: Attestation subnet subscription bitvector (unchanged from Altair).

fields.name: syncnets
fields.description: Sync committee subnet subscription bitvector (unchanged from Altair).

fields.name: custody_group_count
fields.description: The node's custody group count (cgc). New in Fulu.

sub_graphs.name: Gossip Validation: beacon_block (Updated)
sub_graphs.description: Updates the gossip validation rules for the beacon_block global topic to use the dynamic blob parameter system introduced in Fulu. The KZG commitment count is now validated against the epoch-specific blob limit via get_blob_parameters().

invariants.text: [REJECT] The length of KZG commitments MUST be less than or equal to get_blob_parameters(get_current_epoch(state)).max_blobs_per_block.

preconditions.text: The signed_beacon_block must be received on the beacon_block gossip topic.

postconditions.text: Blocks with too many KZG commitments for the current epoch are rejected and not forwarded.

error_cases.result: [REJECT] Block is rejected and not forwarded on gossip

sub_graphs.name: Gossip: blob_sidecar Deprecation
sub_graphs.description: The blob_sidecar_{subnet_id} gossip topic is deprecated in Fulu. Data availability is now provided through the data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} topic as part of the PeerDAS (EIP-7594) transition.

invariants.text: The blob_sidecar_{subnet_id} topic is deprecated in Fulu and MUST NOT be used for new data.

sub_graphs.name: Gossip Validation: data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id}
sub_graphs.description: Defines the complete gossip validation rules for the data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} topic. This is the primary data availability propagation mechanism in Fulu (PeerDAS/EIP-7594). Specifies 13 validation conditions that must pass before forwarding a DataColumnSidecar on the network, using REJECT and IGNORE semantics.

invariants.text: [REJECT] The sidecar MUST be valid as verified by verify_data_column_sidecar(sidecar).
[REJECT] The sidecar MUST be for the correct subnet: compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(sidecar.index) == subnet_id.
[IGNORE] The sidecar MUST NOT be from a future slot (with MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY allowance): block_header.slot <= current_slot.
[IGNORE] The sidecar MUST be from a slot greater than the latest finalized slot: block_header.slot > compute_start_slot_at_epoch(state.finalized_checkpoint.epoch).
[REJECT] The proposer signature of sidecar.signed_block_header MUST be valid with respect to block_header.proposer_index pubkey.
[IGNORE] The sidecar's block's parent (block_header.parent_root) MUST have been seen (via gossip or non-gossip sources).
[REJECT] The sidecar's block's parent (block_header.parent_root) MUST pass validation.
[REJECT] The sidecar MUST be from a higher slot than the sidecar's block's parent.

[REJECT] The current finalized_checkpoint MUST be an ancestor of the sidecar's block: get_checkpoint_block(store, block_header.parent_root, store.finalized_checkpoint.epoch) == store.finalized_checkpoint.root.
[REJECT] The sidecar's kzg_commitments field inclusion proof MUST be valid as verified by verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof(sidecar).
[REJECT] The sidecar's column data MUST be valid as verified by verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs(sidecar).

[IGNORE] The sidecar MUST be the first sidecar for the tuple (block_header.slot, block_header.proposer_index, sidecar.index) with valid header signature, sidecar inclusion proof, and KZG proof (anti-equivocation).

[REJECT] The sidecar MUST be proposed by the expected proposer_index for the block's slot in the context of the current shuffling. If proposer_index cannot be immediately verified, the sidecar MAY be queued (IGNORE instead of REJECT).

preconditions.text: The sidecar must be a well-formed DataColumnSidecar received on a data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} gossip topic.

postconditions.text: Only sidecars passing all REJECT and IGNORE checks are forwarded on the gossip network.

Clients may cache the result of the arguments tuple (sidecar.kzg_commitments, sidecar.kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof, sidecar.signed_block_header) to avoid redundant verification for sidecars of the same block.

error_cases.condition: Sidecar slot not higher than parent slot
Finalized checkpoint is not an ancestor of the sidecar's block
Duplicate sidecar for same (slot, proposer_index, index) tuple
Proposer index does not match expected shuffling (and cannot be queued)

sub_graphs.name: Distributed Blob Publishing via Local Execution Layer
sub_graphs.description: Defines the mechanism for honest nodes to query engine_getBlobsV2 from their local execution-layer client upon receiving a valid beacon_block or data_column_sidecar from gossip. If all blobs matching kzg_commitments are retrieved, they are converted to data columns and imported. This increases the likelihood of incorporating and attesting to the last block when its proposer cannot publish data columns on time.

invariants.text: When using locally retrieved blobs, clients SHOULD skip verification of those blobs (as they come from a trusted local EL).
When importing locally retrieved blobs as data columns, clients MUST behave as if the data_column_sidecar had been received via gossip.
Clients MUST publish the corresponding data_column_sidecar on the data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} topic IF AND ONLY IF they are subscribed to it (due to custody requirements or additional sampling).
Clients MUST update gossip rule related data structures (i.e. anti-equivocation cache) when importing locally retrieved data columns.

preconditions.text: A valid beacon_block or data_column_sidecar must have been received from gossip.
The local execution-layer client must support engine_getBlobsV2.

postconditions.text: If all blobs matching kzg_commitments are retrieved from the local EL, they are converted to data columns and imported into the node's data availability store.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: Status v2 Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Defines the Status v2 protocol (/eth2/beacon_chain/req/status/2/) which extends the Status message with an earliest_available_slot field. This field communicates the slot of the earliest available block the node can serve, accounting for both block and sidecar availability.

invariants.text: If a node can serve all blocks throughout the entire sidecars retention period but NOT all sidecars, it should advertise the earliest slot from which it can serve all sidecars.
If a node can serve all sidecars throughout the entire retention period, it should advertise the earliest slot from which it can serve all blocks.

fields.description: The fork digest at the time of sending.

fields.name: finalized_root
fields.description: The finalized block root.

fields.name: finalized_epoch
fields.description: The finalized epoch.

fields.name: head_root
fields.description: The head block root.

fields.name: head_slot
fields.description: The head slot.

fields.name: earliest_available_slot
fields.description: The slot of the earliest available block (SignedBeaconBlock). New in Fulu:EIP7594.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: BlobSidecarsByRange v1 Deprecation
sub_graphs.description: Deprecates the BlobSidecarsByRange v1 protocol (/eth2/beacon_chain/req/blob_sidecars_by_range/1/) as of FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. Defines the transition period behavior where clients must still serve pre-Fulu blob sidecars.

invariants.text: During the deprecation transition period, clients MUST respond with blob sidecars from range [min(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), FULU_FORK_EPOCH) if the requested range includes epochs in this interval.
Clients MAY respond with an empty list if the requested range lies entirely at or after FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
Clients SHOULD NOT penalize peers for requesting blob sidecars from FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: BlobSidecarsByRoot v1 Deprecation
sub_graphs.description: Deprecates the BlobSidecarsByRoot v1 protocol (/eth2/beacon_chain/req/blob_sidecars_by_root/1/) as of FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. Defines the transition period behavior where clients must still serve pre-Fulu blob sidecars by root.

invariants.text: During the deprecation transition period, clients MUST respond with blob sidecars for block roots in range [min(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), FULU_FORK_EPOCH) if any requested roots correspond to blocks in this interval.
Clients MAY respond with an empty list if all requested roots correspond to blocks at or after FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
Clients SHOULD NOT penalize peers for requesting blob sidecars from FULU_FORK_EPOCH.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: DataColumnSidecarsByRange v1 Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Defines the DataColumnSidecarsByRange v1 protocol (/eth2/beacon_chain/req/data_column_sidecars_by_range/1/) for requesting data column sidecars within a slot range and specific column indices. This is the primary mechanism for syncing missed data columns and backfilling within the MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS window. Replaces BlobSidecarsByRange for data availability sampling in Fulu.

invariants.text: The request MUST be encoded as an SSZ-container.
The response MUST consist of zero or more response_chunk, each containing a single DataColumnSidecar payload.

Clients MUST keep a record of data column sidecars on the epoch range data_column_serve_range = [max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), current_epoch] and MUST support serving requests on this range.
Clients MUST respond with at least the data column sidecars of the first blob-carrying block in range, if they have it, and no more than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS.
Clients MUST include all data column sidecars of each block from which they include data column sidecars (no partial blocks).
Data column sidecars MUST be sent in (slot, column_index) order.
Slots without known data columns MUST be skipped.
The response MUST contain no more than count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS data column sidecars.
Clients MUST respond with data columns from their view of the current fork choice (single chain defined by current head).
Clients MUST respond with data column sidecars that are consistent from a single chain within the context of the request.
Blocks from slots before finalization MUST lead to the finalized block reported in the Status handshake.
Nodes that bootstrap from a weak subjectivity checkpoint MUST backfill the local data columns database to at least data_column_serve_range.

preconditions.text: Before consuming each response chunk, the reader SHOULD verify the sidecar via verify_data_column_sidecar, verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, and verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs.

postconditions.text: After the initial data column sidecar, clients MAY stop responding if their fork choice changes.

fields.name: start_slot
fields.description: The starting slot of the requested range.

fields.name: count
fields.description: The number of slots in the requested range.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: The specific column indices requested.

fields.name: sidecars
fields.description: List of data column sidecars matching the requested range and columns.

error_cases.condition: Peer unable to reply to requests within data_column_serve_range
error_cases.result: Error code 3: ResourceUnavailable. Peer MAY get descored or disconnected.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: DataColumnSidecarsByRoot v1 Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Defines the DataColumnSidecarsByRoot v1 protocol (/eth2/beacon_chain/req/data_column_sidecars_by_root/1/) for requesting data column sidecars by block root and specific column indices. New in Fulu:EIP7594. Uses the DataColumnsByRootIdentifier container for requests.

invariants.text: No more than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS may be requested at a time.
The response MUST consist of zero or more response_chunk, each containing a single DataColumnSidecar payload.
Clients MUST support requesting sidecars since minimum_request_epoch = max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH).
Clients MUST respond with at least one sidecar, if they have it.
Clients SHOULD include a sidecar in the response as soon as it passes gossip validation rules.
Clients SHOULD NOT respond with sidecars related to blocks that fail gossip validation rules.
Clients SHOULD NOT respond with sidecars related to blocks that fail the beacon-chain state transition.

preconditions.text: Before consuming each response chunk, the reader SHOULD verify the sidecar via verify_data_column_sidecar, verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, and verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs.

fields.name: identifiers
fields.description: List of block root and column index pairs identifying the requested sidecars.

fields.name: sidecars
fields.description: List of data column sidecars matching the requested block roots and column indices. Length <= sum(len(r.columns) for r in request).

error_cases.condition: Requested root references a block earlier than minimum_request_epoch
error_cases.result: Peers MAY respond with error code 3: ResourceUnavailable or omit the sidecar from the response.

sub_graphs.name: Req/Resp: GetMetaData v3 Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Defines the GetMetaData v3 protocol (/eth2/beacon_chain/req/metadata/3/) which requests the MetaData of a peer using the extended MetaData definition that includes custody_group_count. No request content is needed.

invariants.text: The response MUST use the new MetaData definition that includes the custody_group_count field.
All other conditions for GetMetaData are unchanged from the Altair p2p networking document.

fields.name: request
fields.description: No request content.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The MetaData of the peer, extended with custody_group_count.

sub_graphs.name: Discovery: ENR eth2 Field (Modified)
sub_graphs.description: Modifies the ENR eth2 field computation for the Fulu fork (EIP-7892). The ENRForkID structure is unchanged but the field value computations are updated. The next_fork_version only changes for regular forks (not BPO forks), while next_fork_epoch accounts for both regular and BPO forks.

invariants.text: ENRs MUST carry a generic eth2 key with a 16-byte value of the node's current fork digest, next fork version, and next fork epoch.
fork_digest is compute_fork_digest(genesis_validators_root, epoch) where epoch is the node's current epoch defined by wall-clock time.
next_fork_version is the fork version corresponding to the next planned regular fork (not BPO forks). If no future fork is planned, next_fork_version = current_fork_version.
next_fork_epoch is the epoch at which the next fork (regular OR BPO fork) is planned. If no future fork is planned, next_fork_epoch = FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.

fields.name: fork_digest
fields.description: compute_fork_digest(genesis_validators_root, epoch) for the node's current wall-clock epoch.

fields.name: next_fork_version
fields.description: Fork version for the next planned regular fork (not BPO forks). Equals current_fork_version if no future fork planned.

fields.name: next_fork_epoch
fields.description: Epoch of next planned fork (regular or BPO). FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH if none planned.

sub_graphs.name: Discovery: Custody Group Count ENR Field
sub_graphs.description: Defines the new 'cgc' ENR field that communicates the node's custody group count for PeerDAS data column discovery. This field must be added once FULU_FORK_EPOCH is assigned any value other than FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.

invariants.text: The cgc field MUST be added to the ENR once FULU_FORK_EPOCH is assigned any value other than FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.
The cgc value is a uint64 big endian integer with no leading zero bytes (0 is encoded as empty byte string).

fields.name: cgc
fields.type: uint64 big endian (no leading zero bytes)
fields.description: Custody group count. 0 is encoded as empty byte string.

sub_graphs.name: Discovery: Next Fork Digest ENR Field
sub_graphs.description: Defines the new 'nfd' (next fork digest) ENR field that communicates the digest of the next scheduled fork, regardless of whether it is a regular or Blob-Parameters-Only fork. This complements the eth2 ENRForkID for more accurate next-fork detection. Must be added once FULU_FORK_EPOCH is assigned a value other than FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.

invariants.text: The nfd field MUST be added to the ENR once FULU_FORK_EPOCH is assigned any value other than FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH.
If no next fork is scheduled, the nfd entry contains the default value (SSZ representation of a zero-filled array).
Nodes MUST evaluate nfd alongside ENRForkID::next_* fields under the eth2 key to form a more accurate view of the peer's intended next fork.
If there is an nfd mismatch, the node MUST NOT disconnect before the fork boundary, but MAY disconnect at/after the fork boundary.
Adding the nfd entry prior to the Fulu upgrade will not impact peering as nodes will ignore unknown ENR entries.

fields.name: nfd
fields.description: The fork digest of the next scheduled fork (regular or BPO). Zero-filled if no next fork scheduled.

sub_graphs.name: Peer Scoring for Custody Compliance
sub_graphs.description: Defines the peer scoring behavior for custody compliance in PeerDAS. Since custody functions are deterministic, a node knows exactly what a peer should be able to respond to, enabling precise accountability.

invariants.text: A node knows exactly what data a peer should custody based on deterministic custody functions.
If a peer does not respond to samples of their custodied rows/columns, a node MAY downscore or disconnect from that peer.

error_cases.condition: Peer fails to respond to custody samples it should be serving
error_cases.result: Node may downscore or disconnect the peer

sub_graphs.name: Supernodes
sub_graphs.description: Defines supernodes as nodes that subscribe to all data column sidecar subnets, custody all data column sidecars, and perform reconstruction and cross-seeding. Supernodes require considerably higher bandwidth, storage, and computation resources. At least one supernode is required on the network for reconstruction of missing data.

invariants.text: A supernode subscribes to ALL data column sidecar subnets.
A supernode custodies ALL data column sidecars.
A supernode performs reconstruction and cross-seeding.
There MUST be at least one supernode on the network for reconstruction of missing data.
A node connected to validator(s) with a combined balance >= 4096 ETH MUST be a supernode (validator custody requirement).

preconditions.text: The node must have considerably higher bandwidth, storage, and computation resources to operate as a supernode.
